parameters.name: X-Glean-Include-Experimental
parameters.description: This endpoint is experimental, so requests must include this header set to `true`. See [How experimental APIs work](https://developers.glean.com/experimental/overview) for details.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Maximum number of clients to return. Defaults to 50. Maximum is 100.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response. Send the same filters that the previous request used.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: JSON-encoded filters that choose which clients are returned. The supported fields are is_enabled, name, client_id, usage_client_id, has_ai_gateway, and supported_app, with the operator EQUALS. Multiple values OR within a filter. Multiple filters AND together. Each field can appear in only one filter. Without an is_enabled filter, only enabled clients are returned. To return enabled and disabled clients, send [{"field":"is_enabled","values":["true","false"]}]. To find the Claude Code clients, send [{"field":"supported_app","values":["CLAUDE_CODE"]}].

schema.description: Filters on client fields, combined with AND.

items.description: One filter on a client field.

field.description:
The client field to filter on.
- is_enabled: "true" matches enabled clients, and "false" matches disabled
  clients.

- name: matches clients whose display_name contains the value, ignoring
  case and surrounding whitespace. Each value is at most 256 characters.

- client_id: matches the client with this OAuth client_id.
- usage_client_id: matches the client with this ai_gateway.usage_client_id.
- has_ai_gateway: "true" matches clients that can call the Glean LLM
  Gateway, which are the clients with ai_gateway. "false" matches the
  other clients.

- supported_app: matches clients whose ai_gateway.supported_apps contains
  the value, such as CLAUDE_CODE. The values are the OAuthClientSupportedApp
  values.

values.description: The values to match. A client matches when any value matches.

items.description: A value to match. Blank values are rejected.

operator.description: The only supported operator is EQUALS. Defaults to EQUALS.

items.title: PlatformOAuthClientFilter
